newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan central depository to start in September.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan central depository to start in September.

text.p: The Central Depository Company of Pakistan (CDC) announced on Tuesday that it would start operating in Pakistan's stock exchanges on September 3.

A CDC official said the central depository system would provide for transparent and efficient transactions through a computerised book entry system and eliminate the present need to count, verify, store and transfer share certifcates.

The CDC is owned by the Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad bourses, Citibank, International Finance Corporation, Muslim Commercial Bank, Habib Bank Ltd, National Investment Trust, Investment Corporation of Pakistan and Pakistan Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation.
